p: rend the heavens: The prophet continues his prayer, desiring God to declare his love toward his Church by miracles and mighty power, as he did in mount Sinai.
the waters to boil: Meaning, the rain, hail, fire, thunder and lightning.
heard: Paul uses the same kind of admiration, 1Co 2:9 marvelling at God's great benefit showed to his Church, by the preaching of the gospel.
that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness: You showed favour toward our fathers, when they trusted in you and walked after your commandments.
ways: They considered your great mercies.
those is continuance: That is, in your mercies, which he calls the ways of the Lord.
shall be saved: You will have pity on us.

righteousnesses are as filthy rags: We are justly punished and brought into captivity, because we have provoked you to anger, and though we would excuse ourselves, yet our righteousness, and best virtues are before you as vile cloths, or (as some read) like the menstruous cloths of a woman.
clay: Even though O Lord by your just judgment you may utterly destroy us as the potter may his pot, yet we appeal to your mercies, by which it has pleased you to adopt us to be your children.
neither remember iniquity for ever: For so the flesh judges when God does not immediately send comfort.
Thy holy cities are a wilderness: Who were dedicated to your service, and to call on your Name.
where our fathers praised thee: In which we rejoiced and worshipped you.
for these things: That is, at the contempt of your own glory? Though our sins have deserved this, yet you will not permit your glory thus to be diminished.
